title: 第802章 你惹上事了第801章 嗲一个试试
slug: 青铜古舟第802章你惹上事了
content_zh:
“什么业务？”沈算问。
“店铺和情报。”文慧怡神色郑重起来。
沈算摇了摇头：“诡市情报网还在发展阶段，能提供的有价值情报太少了。至于店铺……说真的，我也不知何时能开启。”
“修复很难吗？”文慧怡问。
沈算索性放下船桨，任小舟在湖面上随波漂流，看向文慧怡那张绝美的脸庞，反问：“你们对诡市是怎么猜测的？”
“隐于虚空中的残破古老宝器。”文慧怡不假思索。
“是呀，残破。”沈算摆手，“诡市收的税，一直用于修复这宝器，可依旧是杯水车薪。”
“世兄。”文慧怡微微一笑，那笑容里藏着一丝狡黠，“我虽未进去过诡市，但也知道，能隐于虚空中的宝器，再残破也残破不到哪里去。”
沈算一愣，脱口而出：“果然，越漂亮的女孩越会骗人。”
“呵呵，世兄，我很漂亮吗？”文慧怡眨了眨眼，故意往前凑了凑。
“不漂亮。”沈算扭头看向湖面。
“口是心非。”文慧怡白了他一眼，慵懒地往竹椅上一躺，舒展开身子，那宽松的衣裙贴着她曼妙的身形，露出一道惊心动魄的曲线。
这一幕正好被回头的沈算看在眼里，他在心里直呼要命，没好气地说：“文慧怡，你注意点形象，你可是文家大小姐。”
“装着累。”文慧怡不以为意，抬脚将那双修长的腿搁到沈算大腿上，“借世兄大腿一用。”
沈算低头看着那双被白素紧身裤包裹的长腿，无奈道：“你就不怕我把持不住？”
“终是要联姻的。”文慧怡望着天上的白云，语气云淡风轻，“世兄若是把持不住，那小妹就从了呗。”
“文慧怡，你今天不会是被什么妖魔鬼怪附身了吧？”沈算皱眉看着她。
“呵呵，那可不顺了世兄的意？”文慧怡笑罢，脸上的神情微微一变，多了几分认真，“世兄，你们沈氏主族的百年大祭，其实也是一场大型联姻盛会。”
沈算眉头一挑。
“这也是受邀的势力会带着族中年轻一辈前来的原因。”文慧怡补充道。

“哦——”沈算恍然，意味深长地看着她，“所以你是逃出来的？”
“哼，知道了也别说出来。”文慧怡别过脸去。
“好家伙，我帮你挡了枪，连说都不能说了？还有没有天理了？”沈算一脸委屈。
“没有。”文慧怡理直气壮，“本大小姐可是给了你福利的。”
“那我捏一下？”沈算伸出咸猪手，在她小脚上轻轻捏了一把。
“啊——”文慧怡惊呼一声，瞪了他一眼，“真痒！你再捏我可回去告状了，说你非礼我。”
“我可是法外狂徒。”沈算不以为意，“族老最多骂我一顿。”
“行了行了，我怕了你了。”文慧怡缩回脚，抱在怀里，“你别捏，不然小心我赖上你。”
“这话从你嘴里说出来，怎么这么违和呢？”沈算忍不住笑。
content_en:
"What business?" Shen Suan asked.
"Shop and information." Wen Huiyi looked serious.
Shen Suan shook his head: "The Guishi Intelligence Network is still in the development stage, and it can provide too little valuable information. As for the store... to be honest, I don't know when it will be opened."
"Is it difficult to repair?" Wen Huiyi asked.
Shen Suan simply put down the oar and let the boat drift with the waves on the lake. He looked at Wen Huiyi's beautiful face and asked, "How did you guess about Gui Shi?"
"A broken ancient treasure hidden in the void." Wen Huiyi said without thinking.
"Yes, it's broken." Shen Suan waved his hand, "The taxes collected by Guishi have been used to repair this treasure, but it is still a drop in the bucket."
"Brother Shi." Wen Huiyi smiled slightly, with a hint of cunning hidden in that smile, "Although I have never been to Gui City, I also know that a treasure that can be hidden in the void will not be damaged no matter how broken it is."
Shen Suan was stunned and blurted out: "Sure enough, the prettier a girl is, the better she is at lying."
"Haha, brother, am I beautiful?" Wen Huiyi blinked and deliberately moved forward.
"It's not pretty." Shen Suan turned to look at the lake.
"Duplicity." Wen Huiyi rolled her eyes at him, lay down lazily on the bamboo chair, stretched out her body, and the loose dress clung to her graceful figure, revealing a thrilling curve.
This scene happened to be seen by Shen Suan who turned around. He screamed in his heart and said angrily: "Wen Huiyi, please pay attention to your image, you are the eldest lady of the Wen family."
"Pretending to be tired." Wen Huiyi didn't care, she raised her feet and put her slender legs on Shen Suan's lap, "I'll use my brother's thighs."
Shen Suan looked down at his long legs wrapped in white tights and said helplessly, "Aren't you afraid that I can't control you?"
"We will get married eventually." Wen Huiyi looked at the white clouds in the sky and said in a calm tone, "If brother Shi can't control it, then little sister will just accept it."
"Wen Huiyi, are you possessed by some monster today?" Shen Suan frowned and looked at her.
"Haha, isn't that going against Brother Shi's wishes?" Wen Huiyi stopped laughing, and the expression on her face changed slightly, becoming more serious, "Brother Shi, the centenary ceremony of your main Shen clan is actually also a large-scale marriage event."
Shen Suan raised his eyebrows.
"This is also the reason why the invited forces will bring the younger generation of the clan." Wen Huiyi added.
"Oh -" Shen Suan suddenly realized and looked at her meaningfully, "So you escaped?"
"Humph, don't tell me even if you know it." Wen Huiyi looked away.
"Good guy, I blocked the gun for you, can't you even say anything? Is there any justice left?" Shen Suan looked aggrieved.
"No." Wen Huiyi said confidently, "I have given you benefits."
"Then let me pinch it?" Shen Suan stretched out his hands and pinched her feet gently.
"Ah -" Wen Huiyi exclaimed and glared at him, "It's so itchy! If you pinch me again, you can go back and file a complaint, saying you molested me."
"I'm an outlaw." Shen Suan didn't take it seriously. "The most the clan elder can do is scold me."
"Okay, okay, I'm scared of you." Wen Huiyi retracted her feet and held her in her arms, "Don't pinch me, or else I'll rely on you."
"Why are these words so inconsistent when they come out of your mouth?" Shen Suan couldn't help laughing.
